newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends down, trade sells spread.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends down, trade sells spread.

text.p: CSCE world sugar settled near the lows on trade and light speculative selling centered around the March/May spread, dealers said.
They also cited speculative rolling of March contracts into May but said most of the day's volume, estimated at 15,418 lots, was focused on the spreads.
The May contract closed at a 0.02 premium to the spot-March contract, compared with 0.04 on Friday's close.
Traders pegged support in March at 10.47 cents and then at 10.40 cents.
They expect the contract to range from 10.40 to 10.60 cents through Friday's session, when March options expire.
The March contract settled down 0.09 to 10.51, having ranged from 10.58 to 10.49 cents. The back months ended 0.04 and 0.03 lower.
Open interest in the March contract stood at 54,595 lots as of Friday's close, down 2,136 lots from the previous day. About three weeks remain until the contract expires.
Open interest in May rose 567 lots to 37,752 lots.
